Priya K: heads up — customer acme-corp opened a ticket (#789012). SSO stopped working right after their IdP cert rotation earlier today. They see our ACS return 500 and browser shows SAML error. Passing to support for triage :rotating_light:

Ethan T: can you paste the exact error they see? is it a redirect to our ACS with a SAMLResponse or is our endpoint failing before parse?

Priya K: customer says: `500 Internal Server Error` at /saml/acs and our logs show `XMLParseError: invalid token` followed by `saml:InvalidAssertion` once parse starts. They attached the raw SAMLResponse (base64) and their IdP metadata URL.

Lena R: quick checks — often cert rotation leads to either: wrong cert in metadata, metadata endpoint returning HTML (proxy misconfig), or XML encoding/BOM issues. Did they change IdP host or entityID?

Priya K: entityID same. They rotated cert only. Metadata URL: https://idp.acme-corp.com/sso/metadata. I fetched it and got a 200 but body looks like an HTML status page in curl output earlier.

Ethan T: can you run this and paste output? `curl -I https://idp.acme-corp.com/sso/metadata`

Priya K: output: ```
HTTP/2 200
content-type: text/html; charset=UTF-8
content-length: 1256
server: Apache/2.4.52 (Ubuntu)
```
That matches the HTML suspicion. Customer insists metadata is correct on their side.

Lena R: if metadata endpoint returns HTML our SP will try to parse and blow up — produce XML parse errors. Ask them to confirm the metadata path actually serves XML and not a health page. Also check for a UTF-8 BOM at start which breaks some XML parsers.

Priya K: sent steps to customer: (1) verify metadata content-type is `application/samlmetadata+xml` or at least `text/xml`, (2) ensure not behind a maintenance page, (3) confirm metadata starts with `<?xml` not with BOM/whitespace.

Support Bot: Escalation created: ENG-SSO-153. Pinging oncall and eng-security.

Oncall Pager: looped in. @DevSec Sam can you mirror the SAMLResponse they attached and run it through our parser locally? Drop expected fingerprints from their metadata too.

DevSec Sam: I decoded the base64 SAMLResponse. Parser fails on first bytes — there's an unexpected 0xEF 0xBB 0xBF (UTF-8 BOM) prepended. That will break strict XML parser. Also their metadata file has an extra HTML comment injected by a reverse proxy during cert rotation: `<!--maintenance-->` before `<?xml`.

Ethan T: ok that explains `invalid token`. BOM + leading comment. Two fixes: they need to serve raw XML (no BOM, no HTML wrapper) from metadata endpoint. As a temporary workaround we can tolerate leading BOM/whitespace by trimming before parse in our SAML ingestion path. I'll open a small patch request.

Lena R: also confirm cert fingerprint used by their IdP in our config matches the cert in the metadata. If they rotated cert, fingerprint may differ and cause signature validation fails later.

Priya K: customer responded: their ops says new cert deployed but load-balancer served a maintenance page for a short window. They already fixed it and repointed metadata path to the correct backend. They uploaded fresh metadata xml.

DevSec Sam: re-run local validation against the new metadata: `curl -s https://idp.acme-corp.com/sso/metadata | head -n 3` produced: ```
<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\"?>
<EntityDescriptor entityID=\"https://idp.acme-corp.com/\"> 
  <IDPSSODescriptor ...>
```
Good. No BOM, content-type now `application/samlmetadata+xml`. However their certificate subject CN doesn't match previously-stored fingerprint. We'll need to update the configured IdP cert fingerprint for acme-corp in our tenant store.

Ethan T: steps to resolve (short):
1) Customer fixes metadata endpoint (done).
2) They confirm new metadata served — done.
3) We update tenant IdP cert fingerprint on their account -> I can do that once they confirm which certificate to use (upload or metadata).
4) Deploy our tolerant trim patch as a belt-and-braces measure, low-risk (ENG-SSO-153).

Priya K: customer asked how to rotate without downtime. Recommended providing a `metadata-rolling` endpoint during rotation and test with `samltrace` or `SAML Tracer` plugin. Also suggested pre-uploading metadata to our admin console and doing a quick validation before cutover.

Lena R: for records, include repro steps for our docs:
- run `curl -v https://idp.example/sso/metadata` and check for `Content-Type` and no HTML wrapper
- decode SAMLResponse and check first bytes: `echo \"<base64>\" | base64 -d | xxd | head` (look for `ef bb bf`)
- validate cert fingerprint: `openssl x509 -in idp.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256` and compare to metadata KeyDescriptor

Priya K: customer confirmed after updating metadata and our fingerprint update SSO is working again. They asked for a short KB on common rotation pitfalls. I'll draft one and share.

DevSec Sam: action items: update tenant fingerprint (Ethan), merge tolerant trim patch (Ethan + Eng runtime review), add KB article (Priya). ENG-SSO-153 tracks the patch and runtime change.

Ethan T: will do fingerprint update now and open PR for parser trim. ETA 3h. :thumbsup:

Priya K: thanks everyone — closing the high-priority support loop once patch is merged. Marking ticket #789012 resolved on customer side.

Support Bot: Ticket #789012 status -> RESOLVED (customer verified).
